entries.excerpt: * fix(epp): conditionally skip watching InferenceModelRewrite and InferenceObjective when disableK8sCrdReconcile is true This fixes an issue where the controller manager would fail to start if the InferenceModelRewrite or InferenceObjective CRDs were missing. This change introduces a dynamic check for the existence of these CRDs before attempting to set up reconcilers or adding them to the cache.
